cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 73% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.73% · WTI -1.90% · Brent -0.06% · NatGas +2.29%. At the last close, 73% of 67 energy names were green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification did the heavy lifting at +1.14%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.14%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -0.54%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +7.19%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +7.19%, NXT +6.06%, ARRY +4.88%, BE +4.17%, VRT +2.46%. Laggards: NRG -1.75%, BWXT -1.41%, LNG -0.90%, OKLO -0.75%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
